en.title: Minimum Priority Sequence After Swapping Adjacent Items of Different Parity
en.description:
Each time, you may only swap two adjacent items with different parity. Find the lexicographically smallest sequence that can be reached. Each item is a single digit.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n, and the second line contains the digits. The source has no length bound; on this site 1≤n≤200000, 0≤digit≤9.
hints: Take the subsequences of odd digits and of even digits in their original order, and at each step take the smaller of the two heads.
